name: Aarav M.
title: Heavy, soft, holds its shape
body: Washed it five times and the collar still sits right. I went true to size and the fit is relaxed without being baggy.

name: Meera K.
title: The lavender is even better in person
body: Cropped length is perfect with high-rise jeans. The fleece is thick and warm without feeling bulky.

name: Rohan S.
title: Great pockets, size down
body: Love the toggle cuffs and the twill is soft. They run slightly big at the waist so I would size down.

name: Diya R.
title: Wear it every day
body: Comfortable right out of the box. The suede overlays look premium and they go with everything I own.

name: Kabir J.
title: Solid everyday hoodie
body: The hood has real structure and the pocket is deep. Colour faded a little after many washes but still looks good.

name: Ananya P.
title: Statement jacket
body: The satin catches the light beautifully and the padding keeps it warm. Got so many compliments the first night.

name: Vikram N.
title: Nice but short
body: The quality is good but the body is shorter than I expected. Size up if you are tall.

name: Sara T.
title: Fast delivery, easy exchange
body: Needed a different waist size and the exchange was done in four days. The jeans fit perfectly now.
